text:
sec-team: Security advisory: effective in 72h we will block legacy CI secrets (long-lived API tokens) from running in prod. All CI jobs must use OIDC workload identities or short-lived service tokens. See policy: https://redwood.internal/policies/ci-cred-rotation
sec-bot: :warning: Policy enforcement scheduled (policy=CI-EPHEMERAL-1). Jobs using banned token types will be soft-blocked for 24h then hard-blocked.
infra-sre: Action items: 1) enumerate pipelines using legacy tokens, 2) provide migration plan per team, 3) run canary enforcement next week.
ci-owner: I'll produce an inventory and tag owners. ETA for inventory: 24h.
devops: We'll publish an OIDC helper lib + examples in the internal repo: https://git.redwood/internal/ci/oidc-helper and a migration guide.
sec-team: Exceptions allowed only via ticketing; exceptions expire in 7 days and require a compensating control. Open TKT-SEC-279456-LEGACYCI for exceptions.
infra-sre: We'll also add a pre-commit linter to detect embedded tokens and fail builds. Notifying team channels shortly.
sec-bot: Reminder: do NOT post tokens or secrets in this channel. Use vault and secure ticket attachments.
